spells.name: Tesla Coil
spells.desc: Deploy an electrified coil. Detonates when an enemy steps on it. 3×3 shock damage. Placing on an empty tile never ends your turn or uses your spell slot; throwing it directly onto an enemy shocks them on contact and ends your turn.

spells.name: Cloning Machine
spells.desc: Print a decoy clone on an adjacent tile. It draws enemy attention but cannot attack. Placing never uses your spell slot.

spells.name: Chemical Concoction
spells.desc: Hurl the beaker. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 and leaves them Corroded for 2 rounds — one status that burns AND poisons (every Burn and Poison payoff counts it).

spells.name: Plandemic
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in an AOE. Applies Poison.

spells.name: Vivisection
spells.desc: For science. Hold still. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy within 2 and inflicts Grievous Wound for 2 rounds (healing halved).

spells.name: Acid Flask
spells.desc: It eats the plate first. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and lowers its DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Summon Creation
spells.desc: IT'S ALIVE! Stitch a creation together on an adjacent tile. At the end of every round it lumbers 3 tiles toward the nearest enemy and clubs for 90. 4 hits to destroy — physical blows only count for half. One creation per scientist.

spells.name: Love Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers the target's DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Nimble Dodge
spells.desc: Gracefully dash 3 tiles away and vanish for 1 turn. Perfect evasive maneuver. Needs 2 rounds between dodges.

spells.name: Meow
spells.desc: An adorable, disarming meow. All enemies within 2 tiles have their DEF lowered for 3 rounds. Deals no damage.

spells.name: Ninefold Scratch
spells.desc: Nine lives, nine scratches. Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy across 9 hits.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs up to 3 tiles in a straight line.
Dashes through the battlefield. Applies Stagger. The caster charges into melee first.
spells.name: Ram Charge
Transform
spells.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

spells.name: Hydraulic Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Jammed or Staggered targets.

spells.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
spells.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

spells.name: Hydraulic Punch
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Exhaust Cloud
spells.desc: Pump toxic exhaust in a 3x3 cloud for 2 turns. Enemies inside are confused.

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Door Dash
spells.desc: Take the short cut. Shoot a door onto an empty tile within 5, step into a door at your feet and out of that one. No damage, no opportunity strikes — you were never in between.

spells.name: Prism Mirror
spells.desc: Fold a laser-reflecting prism into being on an empty tile (up to 8) for just 1 AP. Folding never ends your turn or uses your spell slot, so you can fold another, Pulse Lattice, move or attack with the AP you have left. Beams auto-connect any of your prisms that share a row or column — enemies that path through a beam are seared, and enemies still standing in one at end of round take burn damage. A prism is sturdy glass: it takes two hits to shatter.

spells.name: Pulse Lattice
spells.desc: Discharge the lattice (needs 3+ prisms): every enemy caught on a beam takes a burst in the current frequency. 4+ prisms across 2+ elevations enclose a 3-D volume — everyone inside is hit and the burst is amplified. 8 prisms in a perfect rectangular prism unleash a massive detonation through the whole volume.

spells.name: Tune Frequency
spells.desc: Shift your whole lattice to the next light frequency — Infrared (fire, burns), Ultraviolet (arcane, shreds DEF), or Gamma (charged, slows) — changing what every one of your beams does. Only once per round.

spells.name: Ego Death
spells.desc: Dissolve the target's sense of self entirely. The world drains away, the colour wheel spins, and what is left of "them" implodes into white light. Deals SEVERE magic damage to a Single Enemy and Stuns them while the pieces reassemble. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

spells.name: Visible Language
spells.desc: They sing, and the song is a solid object. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy within 4 and Discords them for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Mirror Blink
spells.desc: Fold through the light and blink to any tile within 3 — reposition inside your own lattice, or slip out of a collapsing trap.

spells.name: Dimensional Fold
spells.desc: Swaps positions with the target unit.

spells.name: Hellfire Crown
spells.desc: One crown, whoever wears it. Raises the caster's ATK or M ATK by 1 stage — whichever is higher.

spells.name: Infernal Conscription
spells.desc: Report for duty. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy, drags them 3 tiles toward the caster and Fears them for a round.

spells.name: Brutal Slam
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies around the caster and leaves them Grievously Wounded: healing is halved.

spells.name: Cataclysm Decree
spells.desc: Marks a zone. After 1 turn, deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies inside (AOE). Leaves lava tiles behind. Reshapes the ground on impact. Deals bonus damage to Burning targets.

spells.name: Body Check
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and shoves them 2 tiles. Applies Stagger.

spells.name: Curb Stomp
spells.desc: Put an adjacent enemy on the pavement and stomp. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and leaves a Grievous Wound — healing on them is halved for 2 rounds. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Contract
spells.desc: Binds a Single Enemy in an infernal contract for 3 turns: every time they deal damage, the demon collects 40% of it as healing. The fine print always favors the fiend.

spells.name: Tentacle Lash
spells.desc: An arm from below the surface. Deals WEAK water damage to a Single Enemy and drags them 2 tiles toward you.

spells.name: Ink Cloud
spells.desc: Spray blinding ink over a 3×3 area for 2 turns. Enemies inside are disoriented — ATK lowered by 2 stages and DEF by 1 stage for 2 turns.

spells.name: Depth Charge
spells.desc: It goes off under the surface. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies in a 3×3. Anything soaked — or standing in the water — takes the shock through its body: bonus damage to Soaked targets.

spells.name: Great Flood
spells.desc: Call the drowned deep. Water pours into the target tile and RISES to fill the surrounding basin (up to 12 tiles) — meteor craters and trenches flood to the rim, chasms become deep water. Enemies caught take HEAVY magic damage, are slowed, and can start to drown. Flyers up in the sky are above it.

spells.name: Spout
spells.desc: A jet of seawater from the gills. WEAK water damage and the target is soaked through.

spells.name: Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Heals the caster for part of the damage dealt.

spells.name: Howl
spells.desc: The pack answers. Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 ATK stage.

spells.name: Feral Dive
spells.desc: From higher ground, leaps down onto a Single Enemy below you, dealing MEDIUM physical damage.
Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Automatically strikes the visible enemy with the lowest HP.
spells.name: Blood Frenzy

spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. The caster leaps in first.
spells.name: Pounce
Tail Whip
spells.desc: A spinning tail strike. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Tesla Coil
spells.desc: Deploy an electrified coil. Detonates when an enemy steps on it. 3×3 shock damage. Placing on an empty tile never ends your turn or uses your spell slot; throwing it directly onto an enemy shocks them on contact and ends your turn.

spells.name: Cloning Machine
spells.desc: Print a decoy clone on an adjacent tile. It draws enemy attention but cannot attack. Placing never uses your spell slot.

spells.name: Chemical Concoction
spells.desc: Hurl the beaker. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 and leaves them Corroded for 2 rounds — one status that burns AND poisons (every Burn and Poison payoff counts it).

spells.name: Plandemic
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in an AOE. Applies Poison.

spells.name: Vivisection
spells.desc: For science. Hold still. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy within 2 and inflicts Grievous Wound for 2 rounds (healing halved).

spells.name: Acid Flask
spells.desc: It eats the plate first. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and lowers its DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Summon Creation
spells.desc: IT'S ALIVE! Stitch a creation together on an adjacent tile. At the end of every round it lumbers 3 tiles toward the nearest enemy and clubs for 90. 4 hits to destroy — physical blows only count for half. One creation per scientist.

spells.name: Love Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers the target's DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Nimble Dodge
spells.desc: Gracefully dash 3 tiles away and vanish for 1 turn. Perfect evasive maneuver. Needs 2 rounds between dodges.

spells.name: Meow
spells.desc: An adorable, disarming meow. All enemies within 2 tiles have their DEF lowered for 3 rounds. Deals no damage.

spells.name: Ninefold Scratch
spells.desc: Nine lives, nine scratches. Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy across 9 hits.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs up to 3 tiles in a straight line.
Dashes through the battlefield. Applies Stagger. The caster charges into melee first.
spells.name: Ram Charge
Transform
spells.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

spells.name: Hydraulic Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Jammed or Staggered targets.

spells.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
spells.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

spells.name: Hydraulic Punch
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Exhaust Cloud
spells.desc: Pump toxic exhaust in a 3x3 cloud for 2 turns. Enemies inside are confused.

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Door Dash
spells.desc: Take the short cut. Shoot a door onto an empty tile within 5, step into a door at your feet and out of that one. No damage, no opportunity strikes — you were never in between.

spells.name: Prism Mirror
spells.desc: Fold a laser-reflecting prism into being on an empty tile (up to 8) for just 1 AP. Folding never ends your turn or uses your spell slot, so you can fold another, Pulse Lattice, move or attack with the AP you have left. Beams auto-connect any of your prisms that share a row or column — enemies that path through a beam are seared, and enemies still standing in one at end of round take burn damage. A prism is sturdy glass: it takes two hits to shatter.

spells.name: Pulse Lattice
spells.desc: Discharge the lattice (needs 3+ prisms): every enemy caught on a beam takes a burst in the current frequency. 4+ prisms across 2+ elevations enclose a 3-D volume — everyone inside is hit and the burst is amplified. 8 prisms in a perfect rectangular prism unleash a massive detonation through the whole volume.

spells.name: Tune Frequency
spells.desc: Shift your whole lattice to the next light frequency — Infrared (fire, burns), Ultraviolet (arcane, shreds DEF), or Gamma (charged, slows) — changing what every one of your beams does. Only once per round.

spells.name: Ego Death
spells.desc: Dissolve the target's sense of self entirely. The world drains away, the colour wheel spins, and what is left of "them" implodes into white light. Deals SEVERE magic damage to a Single Enemy and Stuns them while the pieces reassemble. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

spells.name: Visible Language
spells.desc: They sing, and the song is a solid object. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy within 4 and Discords them for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Mirror Blink
spells.desc: Fold through the light and blink to any tile within 3 — reposition inside your own lattice, or slip out of a collapsing trap.

spells.name: Dimensional Fold
spells.desc: Swaps positions with the target unit.

spells.name: Hellfire Crown
spells.desc: One crown, whoever wears it. Raises the caster's ATK or M ATK by 1 stage — whichever is higher.

spells.name: Infernal Conscription
spells.desc: Report for duty. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy, drags them 3 tiles toward the caster and Fears them for a round.

spells.name: Brutal Slam
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies around the caster and leaves them Grievously Wounded: healing is halved.

spells.name: Cataclysm Decree
spells.desc: Marks a zone. After 1 turn, deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies inside (AOE). Leaves lava tiles behind. Reshapes the ground on impact. Deals bonus damage to Burning targets.

spells.name: Body Check
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and shoves them 2 tiles. Applies Stagger.

spells.name: Curb Stomp
spells.desc: Put an adjacent enemy on the pavement and stomp. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and leaves a Grievous Wound — healing on them is halved for 2 rounds. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Contract
spells.desc: Binds a Single Enemy in an infernal contract for 3 turns: every time they deal damage, the demon collects 40% of it as healing. The fine print always favors the fiend.

spells.name: Tentacle Lash
spells.desc: An arm from below the surface. Deals WEAK water damage to a Single Enemy and drags them 2 tiles toward you.

spells.name: Ink Cloud
spells.desc: Spray blinding ink over a 3×3 area for 2 turns. Enemies inside are disoriented — ATK lowered by 2 stages and DEF by 1 stage for 2 turns.

spells.name: Depth Charge
spells.desc: It goes off under the surface. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies in a 3×3. Anything soaked — or standing in the water — takes the shock through its body: bonus damage to Soaked targets.

spells.name: Great Flood
spells.desc: Call the drowned deep. Water pours into the target tile and RISES to fill the surrounding basin (up to 12 tiles) — meteor craters and trenches flood to the rim, chasms become deep water. Enemies caught take HEAVY magic damage, are slowed, and can start to drown. Flyers up in the sky are above it.

spells.name: Spout
spells.desc: A jet of seawater from the gills. WEAK water damage and the target is soaked through.

spells.name: Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Heals the caster for part of the damage dealt.

spells.name: Howl
spells.desc: The pack answers. Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 ATK stage.

spells.name: Feral Dive
spells.desc: From higher ground, leaps down onto a Single Enemy below you, dealing MEDIUM physical damage.
Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Automatically strikes the visible enemy with the lowest HP.
spells.name: Blood Frenzy

spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. The caster leaps in first.
spells.name: Pounce
Tail Whip
spells.desc: A spinning tail strike. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.desc: Report for duty. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy, drags them 3 tiles toward the caster and Fears them for a round.

spells.name: Brutal Slam
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies around the caster and leaves them Grievously Wounded: healing is halved.

spells.name: Cataclysm Decree
spells.desc: Marks a zone. After 1 turn, deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies inside (AOE). Leaves lava tiles behind. Reshapes the ground on impact. Deals bonus damage to Burning targets.

spells.name: Body Check
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and shoves them 2 tiles. Applies Stagger.

spells.name: Curb Stomp
spells.desc: Put an adjacent enemy on the pavement and stomp. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and leaves a Grievous Wound — healing on them is halved for 2 rounds. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Contract
spells.desc: Binds a Single Enemy in an infernal contract for 3 turns: every time they deal damage, the demon collects 40% of it as healing. The fine print always favors the fiend.

spells.name: Tentacle Lash
spells.desc: An arm from below the surface. Deals WEAK water damage to a Single Enemy and drags them 2 tiles toward you.

spells.name: Ink Cloud
spells.desc: Spray blinding ink over a 3×3 area for 2 turns. Enemies inside are disoriented — ATK lowered by 2 stages and DEF by 1 stage for 2 turns.

spells.name: Depth Charge
spells.desc: It goes off under the surface. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies in a 3×3. Anything soaked — or standing in the water — takes the shock through its body: bonus damage to Soaked targets.

spells.name: Great Flood
spells.desc: Call the drowned deep. Water pours into the target tile and RISES to fill the surrounding basin (up to 12 tiles) — meteor craters and trenches flood to the rim, chasms become deep water. Enemies caught take HEAVY magic damage, are slowed, and can start to drown. Flyers up in the sky are above it.

spells.name: Spout
spells.desc: A jet of seawater from the gills. WEAK water damage and the target is soaked through.

spells.name: Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Heals the caster for part of the damage dealt.

spells.name: Howl
spells.desc: The pack answers. Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 ATK stage.

spells.name: Feral Dive
spells.desc: From higher ground, leaps down onto a Single Enemy below you, dealing MEDIUM physical damage.
Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Automatically strikes the visible enemy with the lowest HP.
spells.name: Blood Frenzy

spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. The caster leaps in first.
spells.name: Pounce
Tail Whip
spells.desc: A spinning tail strike. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.
